sample_id_rule: `<zip 内路径>#<该路径在 test 中第几次出现>`（过采样会重复，故带出现序号保证唯一）
protocol: 作者原生流程运行时重建：`Unknown*` 合并为 `Unknown` → RandomOverSampler(random_state=83) 过采样 → train_test_split(test_size=0.4, stratify, random_state=42)。该 test 集磁盘上不存在，由 inference/native/run_model.py 现场构造。
label_space: native class ids recorded by the model config (adapter = native_labels); class names are display metadata only.

leakage.note: 过采样发生在切分之前，导致 84.1% 的测试样本是训练集里出现过的重复图；该精度不能当泛化精度看。

reconstruction_dependency.delivery: vendored at inference/vendor/, injected via PYTHONPATH in inference/entrypoint.json
reconstruction_dependency.reason: e07 image does not ship imbalanced-learn and the container runs offline with --network none
reconstruction_dependency.version_source: the original evaluation container sunyuqiyi-c500 had imbalanced-learn 0.14.2
reconstruction_dependency.why_pinned: RandomOverSampler(random_state=83) determines which 9252 rows become the test split; a different version may resample differently and change the score
